card.name: The word twice after a dose
card.fires_on: The word "twice" (or "Twice") right after a dose amount such as mg or mg/kg, where "daily" or "a day" comes next.

modes.label: Twice after mg
modes.description: "twice" directly follows a milligram amount in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: mg<< twice>> daily soft gel capsule ritonavir

modes.label: Twice after weight-based dose
modes.description: "twice" follows a per-kilogram dose in a pediatric or table entry.
modes.example: 25 units/kg<< twice>> daily 8 Years to less than
